fact_text: For an employer-sponsored professional, the Brazilian hiring entity - not the employee - is the interested party that files the residence authorization for labour purposes with the Ministry of Justice via the MigranteWeb system, and the consular VITEM V work visa is issued only after this prior authorization is granted.
evidence_quote: Interessado, pessoa física ou jurídica, que deseje utilizar mão de obra imigrante.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the employee applies for a Brazilian work visa at the consulate first. Actually the Brazilian employer must first obtain a residence authorization from the Ministry of Justice via MigranteWeb; the VITEM V visa is only issued afterwards. Action: have your employer file the autorização de residência in MigranteWeb before booking any consular visa appointment.

fact_text: A correctly filed residence-authorization request for labour purposes is decided in up to 30 days; if it enters 'exigência' (a request for additional information) the deadline extends to up to 60 days, both extendable if needed.
evidence_quote: Processos instruídos corretamente: até 30 (trinta) dias, prorrogáveis, se necessário. Processos que entram 'em exigência': até 60 (sessenta), prorrogáveis, se necessário.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed Brazilian immigration timelines are open-ended. Actually the Ministry commits to up to 30 days for a correctly filed request, or up to 60 if it enters 'exigência'. Action: budget one to two months for the authorization and file a complete dossier to avoid the exigência extension.

fact_text: A foreigner entering Brazil on a temporary visa must register with the Polícia Federal within 90 days of entry to obtain their migratory registration (RNM/CRNM). Missing the deadline can trigger penalties under Decree 9.199/2017.
evidence_quote: Você tem 90 dias após a entrada no Brasil para se registrar.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the visa alone lets you live and work in Brazil with nothing further to do on arrival. Actually you must register in person with the Polícia Federal within 90 days of entry or face penalties. Action: book the PF registration appointment as soon as you arrive - do not wait.

fact_text: If the residence authorization is granted while the professional is already in Brazil, the Federal Police registration must be completed within 30 days of the authorization's publication in the Diário Oficial - a tighter window than the 90 days that applies to temporary-visa entrants.
evidence_quote: Você tem 30 dias após a publicação da autorização no Diário Oficial para se registrar.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed everyone gets 90 days to register with the PF. Actually residence-authorization holders whose grant is published in the Diário Oficial have only 30 days from publication. Action: track the DOU publication date and register within 30 days if you obtained the authorization in-country.

fact_text: Completing Federal Police registration produces a Registro Nacional Migratório (RNM) number and the Carteira de Registro Nacional Migratório (CRNM) - the physical foreigner ID card that, rather than the passport, is the identity document used for daily life in Brazil.
evidence_quote: Após isso, você receberá um número de Registro Nacional Migratório (RNM) e a Carteira de Registro Nacional Migratório (CRNM).

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed your passport is enough to identify yourself day to day in Brazil. Actually the CRNM (with its RNM number) is the recognised foreigner ID for banks, contracts and public services, and it only exists after PF registration. Action: treat the CRNM as your primary Brazilian ID and quote the RNM number on all official forms.

fact_text: Issuing the CRNM requires paying a federal fee (GRU) of R$ 204,77 under revenue code STN 140120, separate from any residence-authorization or consular visa costs.
evidence_quote: Taxa de emissão da Carteira de Registro Nacional Migratório - código da receita STN 140120 R$ 204,77

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the visa fee covers the ID card as well. Actually the CRNM carries its own federal GRU fee of R$ 204,77 (revenue code STN 140120) paid at registration. Action: pay the CRNM GRU before your PF appointment and bring the paid receipt.

entity_title: Register at PF unit of your domicile
fact_text: Federal Police migratory registration is handled only by the PF unit covering the circunscrição (district) where the applicant is domiciled, so a São Paulo-based professional must register at a São Paulo PF unit and needs a settled local address first.
evidence_quote: o atendimento ocorrerá somente na unidade da Polícia Federal da circunscrição onde esteja domiciliado o requerente

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed you can register at any Federal Police office. Actually service is provided only at the PF unit of your domicile's circunscrição. Action: secure your São Paulo address first, then book the appointment at the PF unit that covers that district.

entity_title: CPF required for bank and assets
fact_text: A foreigner is required to register in the CPF (Receita Federal taxpayer number) to hold assets and rights subject to public registration in Brazil - including a bank current account, real estate or a vehicle - making the CPF a practical prerequisite for banking, housing and contracts.
evidence_quote: Imóveis; veículos; embarcações; aeronaves; contas-correntes bancárias; aplicações em mercado financeiro; aplicações em mercado de capital

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the CPF is only for filing income tax. Actually it is legally required to hold a bank account, property or vehicle in Brazil and is demanded almost everywhere for contracts. Action: obtain a CPF (it can be requested even before arrival, at a Brazilian consulate) as one of your first administrative steps.

fact_text: A professional employed in Brazil becomes a mandatory INSS (social security) insured automatically upon starting remunerated activity linked to the RGPS; enrolment is not an optional sign-up and contributions are withheld from the first payroll.
evidence_quote: O ato de filiação para os segurados obrigatórios ocorrerá de forma automática a partir do exercício de atividade remunerada vinculada ao Regime Geral de Previdência Social - RGPS.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed social-security enrolment is a separate step the employee must complete. Actually filiação to the INSS/RGPS is automatic the moment paid work begins, and contributions are mandatory. Action: expect INSS deductions from your first payslip and check your home-country totalization agreement to avoid double contributions.

fact_text: A foreign driving licence lets a resident drive in Brazil for a maximum of 180 days (respecting the original licence's validity); to keep driving after that the holder must obtain a Brazilian CNH through the DETRAN of their place of domicile.
evidence_quote: prazo máximo de 180 (cento e oitenta) dias, respeitada a validade da habilitação de origem

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed an international driving permit lets you drive indefinitely in Brazil. Actually a foreign licence is valid for at most 180 days from entry; after that you must convert to a Brazilian CNH at your local DETRAN. Action: start the CNH process at your São Paulo DETRAN well before day 180.
